question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment.
Such great accomplishment belongs to the practitioner.
This accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginis.
inference: A practitioner possessing the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: One who attains the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
